Running into Claymores is literally carelessness. I know man, we have all been into that. You run around a corner, probably want revenge on some guy. Boom. You are dead.

It also happens randomly, some guy cleverly places the Claymores at his flanks. Or that one time I placed a Claymore directly in the "out of nowhere" area south of F on Golmud Conquest Large - someone really ran into it.

But - the thing I described above is a one in a million occurence. Most of the time people place it in doorways. And that is perfectly fine. If you don't run around careless you will never run into a claymore.


You either:

1) Throw a grenade at it
2) Shoot the claymore at a safe distance
3) Wait till a friendly hits the claymore and revive him/heal him
4) Simply go the other flank.

It does not warrant a nerf in any way. It is a very situational tool, if you nerf it, no one will ever use it again. Same as the nerf was too much with the SLAMs (and keep in mind, I never used them much, but still think the nerf to them was too much)

1.) You can never see your own soldier's face anyway

2.) Having to render more detailed/different faces per character adds unnecessary strain to the game's performance

3.) When I am in a firefight I want to be able to immediately tell which threat I am facing

4.) Adding this in would bring absolutely nothing new to the gameplay table and would waste valuable resources
